decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans46TG0/VA/2 B submitted 11 February 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank doors, windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house to provide a bedroom and bathroom for a disabled person
